messages:
lina: Quick heads-up — GCP Marketplace PO for Nimbus Inc. is failing vendor validation in procurement. They say vendor tax ID on PO != vendor registry. Anyone familiar with this flow? cc @raj @emma

raj: Is this from the public marketplace UI or from an ISV purchase path? If public, buyer portal usually mints the PO. Need example payload.

emma: It's from marketplace UI. Procurement attached PO PDF, shows vendor as "Nimbus Cloud LLC" but marketplace registry = "Nimbus Technologies, Inc." Procurement blocked payment.

marco: invoices are bouncing because vendor alias doesn't match our remittance entity. Finance can patch remittance if we have vendor legal name + EIN. Temporary manual AR accepted but need legal sign-off.

lina: @sofia (legal) any quick guidance on accepting vendor alias mismatch? can we accept an addendum or does this need a contract redline?

sofia (legal): Short: vendor alias mismatch isn't a deal-breaker if we have a signed contract showing acceptance of alias OR an addendum confirming remittance entity. If procurement needs marketplace PO to match verbatim we'd request vendor to update their profile. Quick path: vendor signs a one-page remittance addendum we supply.

emma: vendor is pushing back — they say updating marketplace entity will take 2+ days. Customer procurement wants immediate invoice to start project. Can we do manual PO intake with addendum and later sync to marketplace?

raj: Marketplace ops (cc @marketplace-ops-bot) — can we accept manual PO workflow? Also any way to update vendor alias quicker from our side?

marketplace-ops-bot: Automated message: Marketplace support can process alias correction requests; SLA for corrections = 48 hours. Emergency escalation possible with partner ops approval.

sofia (legal): Proposed path: 1) Send vendor remittance addendum to sign today. 2) Accept manual PO ingestion for billing (finance to patch). 3) Raise marketplace alias correction ticket (ops) to reconcile for future invoices. That keeps procurement happy and preserves audit trail.

marco: I'll create manual AR and confirm once invoice accepted. Need vendor EIN + signed addendum.

lina: I'll draft addendum and send to vendor now. @emma can you own the intake with procurement and confirm PO reference? I'll escalate alias correction to ops. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

emma: On it — looping in procurement now.

lina: Closing note: timeline expectation — vendor sign today, finance invoice within 24h, ops alias fix within 48h. Updating deal desk thread after vendor signs.
